messages:
kate (product): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — let's collect the canary/flag remediation items in one place. Add owner + ETA. I'll coordinate.

aj: I can own auto-rollback rules. Proposal: pause flag + route to stable if error-rate delta >3% OR p95 latency increases by 50% sustained for 120s. Auto-unpause only after manual review.

lee: I'll own the flag-level telemetry and dashboards. Need per-flag p50/p95, error-rate by cohort, and a short sampling path for rollback decisioning (we shouldn't rely on full traffic until validated).

sre_jordan: Draft of a lightweight auto-rollback condition (proto):
```json
{
  'trigger': { 'metric': 'error_rate', 'delta_pct': 3, 'window_s': 120 },
  'action': 'pause_flag',
  'fallback_variant': 'stable',
  'notify': ['#incidents','#eng-platform']
}
```
Keep it simple initially; we can add hysteresis later.

maria: I'll take the blast-radius matrix mapping (impact tiers + allowed ramp strategies). Initial rule: tier-3 features need manual approval for any >1% ramp; tier-2 auto canary up to 5% with auto-rollback enabled; tier-1 can use fast ramps. ETA Tue EOD.

aj: Tactical immediate change: reduce default canary sampling to 0.5% and cap per-flag daily exposure to 100k users until we finish the matrix. Ramp plan: 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% over 24h only if no regressions.

lee: For detectors, we'll add a change-point alert on error_rate and latency using 4x baseline noise with a 3-sample confirmation. I'll add dashboards and a synthetic test to exercise the detector. ETA Wed.

ops-bot: Reminder: Follow-up review meeting created — Friday 10:00 PT. Agenda: owners update, PRs, rollout playbook.

kate (product): Can everyone post owner + ETA here by EOD tomorrow? I'll book the review and run through the matrix. :calendar: :thumbsup:

maria: assigned -> blast-radius matrix, ETA Tue EOD.
aj: assigned -> auto-rollback PR + canary caps, ETA Mon noon.
sre_jordan: assigned -> PR for simple rollback rule and ops integration, ETA Mon EOD.
lee: assigned -> dashboards + detector + synthetic, ETA Wed EOD.

kate (product): Great. After PRs land we'll do a short canary drill (controlled test) next week. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
